repos_data.description: CLI tool and library for generating a Software Bill of Materials from container images and filesystems

AI supply-chain BOM: every agent, MCP server and AI package, and what each one can reach. Open-source scanner and self-hosted control plane for code, containers, cloud and AI. Self-host free; local scans need no account.

BomLens — a local-first SBOM generator & open-source risk assessor (CycloneDX). Produce an SBOM, an open-source notice, and a security/license risk report from source code, containers, binaries, firmware, or an SBOM you received. CLI or web UI, no SaaS.
Open source attack-path engine for AWS and Kubernetes: correlates your scanners into one graph and blocks the pull request that opens a route to your data.

MCP server for CVE intelligence: 16 read-only tools for CVE records, CISA KEV, EPSS history, exploits, fix guidance as sources state it, version, SBOM and lockfile checks, vendor advisories, and per-CVE exposure from Shodan data (© Shodan). Free and keyless.
MCP server for SecObserve: triage vulnerability findings, manage products and rules, import scan reports and SBOMs, generate VEX documents
